clue.text: Time to probe messy, corrupt organisation

indicators.note: a probe pushes into something, so the T goes inside the other letters
corrupt means spoiled or altered, so the letters of messy are rearranged

explanation.surface: A disorganised, crooked body is about to be investigated over time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'corrupt' turns MESSY into SYSEM, and T for time goes into it ('to probe').
explanation.definitionFit: A system is an organised scheme or arrangement, a synonym for organisation.

clue.text: Ship wrecked on shore round cape

explanation.walkthrough: 'wrecked' turns ON SHORE into SHOONER, which go 'round' C for cape.
explanation.definitionFit: A schooner is a sailing vessel with two or more masts, a kind of ship.

clue.text: European team close to defeat and departure

clue.text: Some theatre sisters do not comply

parts.note: amen is said at the end of a prayer, the final word
